eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 10:27 AM on AUG 17, 2021 Effective until 8:27 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Prescott Valley Police Department.  This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety.  Prescott Valley Police Department is looking for John Robertson Winstead, seventy nine years of age, white male, five foot eight inches tall, one hundred sixty pounds, with gray hair and brown eyes, wearing a brown striped sweater and blue jeans. Last seen driving a two thousand eight red Chevy Colorado, license plate, C, F, B, 7, 6, 8, 2. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
